trunks.name: The Bio-Root
trunks.trigger: I started as a biologist. That's not the detour — that's the source code.

threads.name: NITW Biotech
threads.trigger: Top 1% nationally. C++ before I knew what a pipeline was.
threads.detail: B.Tech Biotechnology Engineering, NIT Warangal. AIEEE top 1% nationally. MITACS-funded research internship at McGill. Merit scholarship 2011–12. The computation habits formed here.

threads.name: UBC M.Sc.
threads.trigger: Best Student Talk at Banff — only M.Sc. in a room of PhDs.
threads.detail: Fully funded NSERC Scholar. Arabidopsis thesis: diurnal regulation of lignin biosynthetic genes. RNA-seq, statistical analysis on messy biological datasets. The thesis was a data project. (Note: parchment reads Botany; work was molecular/cell biology — see degree-wording task.)

threads.name: Science Communicator
threads.trigger: Explaining DNA to Grade 8 kids. The IIA talk came from here.
threads.detail: GenomeBC / Let's Talk Science. Genomics workshops Grades 8–12. Explaining complex things simply is a practiced skill, not a personality trait.

trunks.name: Bio-Adjacent Circuit
trunks.trigger: Post-MSc: tried three directions. Then tried a PhD. The pivot story runs through all of this.

threads.name: StemShock Startup
threads.trigger: Formulated an mRNA herbicide. Got a raise in 3 months. Company was acquired.
threads.detail: Biological Technician, StemShock Inc. (acq. by Terramera). Formulated RNAi mRNA herbicide. Supported investor fundraising. Multi-hat startup context: first time bridging science to business communication.

threads.name: Freelance Research
threads.trigger: Literature review for a psychiatrist. Federal forestry lab contract.
threads.detail: Core Medical Centre (mental health lit review) + Natural Resources Canada contract. Domain-transfer proof: the research methodology is portable across fields.

threads.name: UofT PhD
threads.trigger: Started a PhD. Left. That decision led to Lantern — and eventually Snowflake.
threads.detail: PhD student, U of Toronto. Conifer cold tolerance (dehydrin proteins). A+ in Computational Biology & Bioinformatics — Python SNP analysis in microbial genomes. The pivot wasn't drift.

trunks.name: The Deliberate Pivot
trunks.trigger: Left a PhD, went back to school for data, then shipped four projects in three months.

threads.name: Lantern Data Cert.
threads.trigger: 91st percentile on DataCamp. Four months, then immediately shipped projects.
threads.detail: Data Analytics & Data Science Certificate, Lantern Institute, Toronto. SQL, Tableau, R, Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, keras). The pivot was a structured 4-month commitment, not a drift.

threads.name: 4 Projects in 3 Months
threads.trigger: A fintech dashboard, health viz, two Kaggles. Three months.
threads.detail: Interac KPI dashboard (Tableau). Samsung Health viz app (Dash/Plotly, GCP App Engine). Kaggle: Credit Card Fraud (Autoencoder + XGBoost, +12%). Kaggle: NLP Tweets (87% accuracy). Breadth-first entry.

threads.name: BugSeq Taxonomy DB
threads.trigger: SQLite from NCBI FTP to validate a microbial taxonomy ML model. Biology met DE.
threads.detail: Data Scientist Intern, Next Gen Microbiology. NCBI Taxonomy FTP → SQLite. Schema design to validate BugSeq ML model. First explicit DE work — and first time biology knowledge directly accelerated it.

threads.name: Protein ML (Waterloo)
threads.trigger: Bayesian hyperparameter search through combinatorial protein sequence space.
threads.detail: ML Intern, U of Waterloo. Feature extraction from protein databases. Ensemble ML + Bayesian tuning (Hyperopt) + Dask parallelism. QSAR prediction. Research-grade ML fluency, not just applied tooling.

trunks.name: Production Data Engineering
trunks.trigger: 2.5 years shipping real pipelines and compliance automation at Snowflake itself.

threads.name: Pipeline Architect (20+)
threads.trigger: GitHub GraphQL, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Okta — 20+ APIs, one CI/CD pipeline.
threads.detail: Data Engineer, Snowflake, Pune. Among earliest Pune office employees. ELT via Lambda, API Gateway, External Functions, Fivetran, Airflow. SnowPro Core Certified. DataShare proposal for GitHub data.

threads.name: SOX Compliance Automation
threads.trigger: SQL that replaced 100+ manual audit hours per quarter. Audit became a partner team.
threads.detail: Real-time SQL monitoring: Access Management exceptions, SSO/SCIM gaps, Password Control violations. 100+ audit hours saved per quarter. Changed business processes. Not just pipelines — systems that change behaviour.

threads.name: 7 Audiences + IIA
threads.trigger: Presented SOX architecture to the Institute of Internal Auditors, San Jose.
threads.detail: 7 external customer presentations. IIA San Jose chapter. Represented Snowflake at US industry events. A Data Engineer who presents to external auditors is unusual. Connects directly to Banff 2014.

trunks.name: Genomics–Cloud Bridge
trunks.trigger: The one role where biology and production cloud engineering happened simultaneously.

threads.name: Algorithmic Biologics
threads.trigger: Gene expression app to AWS. Batch → GKE. Biology + cloud + production. All three at once.
threads.detail: Cloud Engineer, Algorithmic Biologics, Bengaluru. Deployed Tapestry gene expression app to AWS. AWS Batch → GKE migration. Collaborated with bioinformaticians on variant calling. For bio roles: this is already the work.

trunks.name: AI Tools Era
trunks.trigger: Built independently. Got clear on what I want.

threads.name: 7 AI Apps
threads.trigger: Seven friction-killers in a chat window. No pipeline, no team.
threads.detail: ReceiptIQ (Gemini Vision), Daily dashboard (Skyfield + Sheets), FOLIO (mutual funds), Gamified interview prep (SQLite + XP), Write-like-me, Noetone (TTS audiobook), AI quiz. Each from a real friction point. 'The syntax got cheap. The judgment didn't.'

threads.name: catadoption_pune
threads.trigger: ~120 street cats adopted in 6 months. Data-driven animal welfare.
threads.detail: Founder. ~120 Indie cats adopted. Same Streamlit/Gemini/Plotly stack as portfolio apps. Measurable outcomes, real community impact. The AI tooling isn't padding — it's applied to a real problem.

threads.name: Upwork Freelancer
threads.trigger: Selling custom AI quiz and training apps to small teams. Skills become services.
threads.detail: Freelance AI tools developer. Custom quiz and training app builds. Commercial validation — not just portfolio exploration.

threads.name: Snowflake GenAI Cert
threads.trigger: Labs-first. Snowflake domain meets GenAI — intentional positioning.
threads.detail: Snowflake GenAI Professional Certificate (Coursera). Labs-first approach. Positioning at the intersection of deep Snowflake expertise and the GenAI wave.

throughlines.name: The Presentation Thread
throughlines.trigger: This has been true since 2014. Not a skill listed — a habit built.

throughlines.name: Biology as Domain Accelerator
throughlines.trigger: The biology is not background — it keeps paying dividends.

throughlines.name: Funded by Competitive Selection
throughlines.trigger: I moved countries fully funded, on merit. More than once.

throughlines.name: I Think in Systems
throughlines.trigger: 'A data engineer who thinks in systems and loves taking friction out of them.'
